system_chrome.what: status bar clock: SpringBoard draws 9:41 in the style the app's scene asks for, and applies a change of style late enough on a loaded runner to be photographed in the old colour
status bar indicators: signal, Wi-Fi and battery, drawn by SpringBoard in the same lagging style as the clock

home indicator: SpringBoard's bar, 144 by 5 points, 8 points above the bottom edge, at 3x with three pixels of margin; drawn at launch and withdrawn once backboardd reports attention lost, which a loaded GitHub runner never does
